matches.description: Watch Sporting CP vs Tondela highlights and goals from Primeira Liga on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on April 29, 2026. The Primeira Liga clash on April 29, 2026 , provided a masterclass in late-game drama as Sporting CP and Tondela fought through a grueling encounter that defied all logic in its closing stages. Fans at the stadium witnessed a match where momentum shifted like the tide, ensuring the result remained in doubt until the very last second. A Tense Tactical Battle The match began with both sides feeling each other out, leading to a fragmented first half defined more by the referee’s whistle than goalmouth action. Sporting CP attempted to establish dominance early through Geovany Quenda and Geny Catamo , but Tondela remained disciplined, albeit at a cost. The visitors saw several players enter the book, with Rony Lopes and Pedro Henryque receiving yellow cards for rough challenges and unsportsmanlike conduct respectively. Sporting ’s Eduardo Quaresma also found himself cautioned just before the break, reflecting a physical half where clear-cut chances were a rarity. Suarez Breaks the Deadlock The second half saw a significant shift in energy, particularly after a triple substitution by the hosts in the 57th minute. The introduction of Trincao and Salvador Blopa proved inspired. In the 62nd minute, Trincao unlocked the defense with a precision key pass, allowing Salvador Blopa to square the ball for Luis Suarez . The striker made no mistake, firing home with his right foot to give Sporting CP a deserved 1-0 lead. The pressure continued to mount, and in the 78th minute, the lead was doubled under unfortunate circumstances for the visitors. A dangerous ball into the box resulted in Joao Silva inadvertently turning the ball into his own net, seemingly putting Sporting in total control. Stoppage-Time Insanity What followed in the final minutes will be remembered as one of the most chaotic sequences of the season. It began in the 91st minute when Giorgi Kochorashvili tripped Hugo Felix in the area, conceding a penalty. Makan Aiko stepped up for Tondela , but his effort was brilliantly parried by the goalkeeper. However, the reprieve for the hosts was short-lived. From the resulting corner delivered by Hugo Felix , Salvador Blopa went from hero to villain, slicing the ball into his own net to make it 2-1 and breathing life back into the away side. With the clock ticking deep into added time, Tondela threw everything forward in a desperate bid to find an equalizer. In the 94th minute, Hugo Felix once again proved to be the architect of the chaos, swinging in a perfect corner from the right. Cicero , who had come on as a late substitute, rose highest in a crowded penalty area to head the ball home, completing a stunning comeback to level the score at 2-2. Despite Sporting 's 64% possession and late attempts to find a winner in the final seconds, the points were shared in a match that perfectly illustrated the unpredictable nature of football.

The Estádio Municipal de Arouca set the stage for an intense battle on 2026-05-16, with both sides desperate for points in this Primeira Liga encounter. Fans were treated to a match defined by tactical shifts and moments of individual brilliance that kept the atmosphere electric until the final whistle. Fukui Sets the Tone Arouca initiated the contest with aggressive intent, seeking to break through a disciplined Tondela defensive line. Their persistence paid off in the 20th minute when Taichi Fukui unleashed a stunning right-footed strike from outside the penalty area, leaving the goalkeeper with no chance. The goal ignited the home crowd, but the remainder of the first half became a gritty tactical battle. Tensions flared as the referee reached for his pocket, issuing yellow cards to Omar Fayed , Cicero , and Bas Kuipers as both teams fought fiercely for midfield supremacy. Tondela Strike Back Amid VAR Drama After the interval, Tondela emerged with renewed energy, pushing higher up the pitch to find an equalizer. Their efforts were rewarded in the 65th minute when Rony Lopes found space outside the box and fired home a right-footed shot, assisted by Makan Aiko . The celebrations were briefly put on hold for a lengthy VAR review, but the goal was eventually upheld. The equalizer forced Arouca to regroup, leading to a series of tactical substitutions that would ultimately change the course of the match. Late Surge Secures the Points Arouca regained their lead in the 77th minute through a moment of clinical execution. Alfonso Trezza rose highest in the box to head home a precise cross from Tiago Esgaio , following a well-delivered corner by Taichi Fukui . With momentum firmly on their side, the hosts doubled down on their advantage. In the 85th minute, substitute Hyun-Ju Lee capitalized on an assist from Dylan Nandin to slot the ball home, making it 3-1. Despite a late offside call against Lee and some frantic pressure from Tondela in stoppage time, Arouca maintained their composure to claim all three points.

As the clock ticked towards full-time, the atmosphere grew increasingly heated. The stoppage time period was marred by several incidents, leading to yellow cards for Cedric Teguia and Jordan Pefok . The tension reached its boiling point in the 94th minute when the referee showed a direct red card to Maracas for unsportsmanlike conduct.
